A '''battle''' was fought at [[Mandallia]] between the [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] and the [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|Mandalorian Protectors]] during the early stages of the [[Nagai–Tof War]]. The Nagai had already established a number of bases in the [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalore sector]] when the Mandalorians staged an assault on [[Mandallia]]. The cost of the battle was high, but the Nagai were eventually driven off of the planet. Shortly after, [[Fenn Shysa]] learned the invaders' next target was [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] itself.
